approved_home_text: I’m Carl, a filmmaker from Perth. I travel with a camera, follow my curiosity and share the people, places and practical details along the way.
A camera. A little curiosity. See where it goes.
And the life you’re curious about.
The kit that comes with me
From busking in Berlin to filming martial arts across Asia, my work follows the things I’m curious enough to try. Carl Travels is where the films meet the useful details from being there.
Busking for Berlin follows the street music scene that became part of my own life. Start here if you want to see where the filmmaking came from.

cards.title: Korcula Travel Guide
cards.description: Explore Korčula, Croatia, with Carl Travels' ultimate guide. Watch a video tour, see stunning images, and discover ferries, accommodation, beaches, Old Town, and wineries.

cards.title: Hanoi Travel Guide: Three Days to One Week
cards.description: Plan a realistic Hanoi trip: where to stay, a flexible itinerary, food, local transport, accessibility and day trips, with Carl’s original travel films.

cards.title: How to Visit Japan on a Budget
cards.description: Discover how to travel Japan on a budget in 2025 with Carl Travels’ guide. Learn money-saving tips on accommodation, food, transport, and attractions from firsthand experience.
